note: R36 — what kind of answer each need calls for, for the 23 subdomains without a verified service in R35. A national hotline or a tax procedure is not a missing local establishment. national=true: served by an official national channel (the coverage counts it as remote by nature). placeIsService: an official directory record of one of the subdomain's place types IS the public service (a mairie, a CCAS, a health centre), not just a building. Local routes marked verified=false are referral hints for reviewers, never shown as facts.
